schedule.enabled.label: Restart the active world every day
schedule.how.heading: How it works
schedule.how.join: If someone joins during the warning, the restart stops, they are told in the game, and Foreman waits again.
schedule.how.never: A stopped or crashed server is never started by the schedule, and a restart missed while Foreman was not running is not made up.
schedule.how.skip: If players are still online when the wait limit runs out, that day's restart is skipped.
schedule.how.wait: At the set time, Foreman waits until nobody is online.
schedule.how.warn: Then it restarts the server after warning players in the game for {seconds} seconds.
schedule.limit.error: Enter a whole number of hours from 0 to {max}.
schedule.limit.hint: Hours, 0 to {max}. 0 skips the restart at once if anyone is online.
schedule.limit.label: Wait for players to leave for up to
schedule.state.on: Foreman restarts the active world every day at {time} ({zone}). Next restart: {next}.
